name: Walk-up Duplex
author: Companion Intelligence
style: A four-storey dark brick block on a city street with white-railed access walkways across its face, a long flight of steps up to the first of them, a stair tower at one end and parking and stores on the ground floor; the family's duplex apartment takes the middle bay of the second and third floors, a kitchen and dining room opening onto a balcony over the back court, a living room with a desk against a brick wall, the family stair rising to three bedrooms, a bath and a study landing, with its neighbours' flats closed on either side and a flat roof above
